hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *hiragaunsou-vehicle-pl-extracted*.ts|*hiragaunsou-vehicle-pl-extracted*.tsx) (cd hiragaunsou-vehicle-pl-extracted && npm run typecheck) ;; esac; }

cd "hiragaunsou-vehicle-pl-extracted" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if ! git diff --quiet -- . 2>/dev/null || ! git diff --cached --quiet -- . 2>/dev/null; then if ! npm run test -- --run >/tmp/hiragaunsou-test-stop.log 2>&1; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"hiragaunsou-vehicle-pl: npm run test が失敗しています(詳細: /tmp/hiragaunsou-test-stop.log)。修正してください。\"}"; fi; fi
